verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ מֶ֥תֶג הָאַמָּ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·yaḵ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·yaḵ·nî·‘êm way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- me·ṯeḡ hā·’am·māh mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . David defeated the Philistines subdued them and took . . . Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, Davi bateu os filisteus, e os subjugou, e tirou das suas mãos as rédeas da metrópole.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב וַֽיְמַדְּדֵ֤ם בַּחֶ֙בֶל֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ב אוֹתָ֣ם אַ֔רְצָה וַיְמַדֵּ֤ד שְׁנֵֽי־ חֲבָלִים֙ לְהָמִ֔ית וּמְלֹ֥א הַחֶ֖בֶל לְהַחֲי֑וֹת וַתְּהִ֤י מוֹאָב֙ לְדָוִ֔ד לַעֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י מִנְחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ ’eṯ- mō·w·’āḇ way·mad·də·ḏêm ba·ḥe·ḇel haš·kêḇ ’ō·w·ṯām ’ar·ṣāh way·mad·dêḏ šə·nê- ḥă·ḇā·lîm lə·hā·mîṯ ū·mə·lō ha·ḥe·ḇel lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ wat·tə·hî mō·w·’āḇ lə·ḏā·wiḏ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm nō·śə·’ê min·ḥāh
verses.literal: David also defeated the Moabites made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a cord He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death and with one length those to be spared So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute
verses.literalPt: Bateu também a Moabe e mediu-os com cordel, fazendo-os deitar por terra; deles mediu dois cordéis para os matar e um cordel inteiro para os conservar em vida. Os moabitas tornaram-se servos de Davi e pagavam-lhe tributos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ דָּוִ֔ד אֶת־ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהָשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ben- rə·ḥōḇ me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh bə·leḵ·tōw lə·hā·šîḇ yā·ḏōw bin·har-
verses.literal: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob king of Zobah who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River
verses.literalPt: Bateu também Davi a Hadadezer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá, quando foi estabelecer o seu domínio sobre o rio.

verses.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֜ד מִמֶּ֗נּוּ אֶ֤לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵאוֹת֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·kōḏ dā·wiḏ mim·men·nū ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘- mê·’ō·wṯ pā·rā·šîm wə·‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš raḡ·lî way·‘aq·qêr dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·re·ḵeḇ way·yō·w·ṯêr mim·men·nū mê·’āh rā·ḵeḇ
verses.literal: David captured from him a thousand chariots seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers . . . and he hamstrung all the horses . . . except a hundred he kept for the chariots
verses.literalPt: Davi tomou-lhe mil e setecentos cavaleiros e vinte mil homens de pé; jarretou a todos os cavalos dos carros, mas deles reservou para cem carros.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק לַעְזֹ֕ר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִד֙ בַּֽאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ’ă·ram dam·me·śeq la‘·zōr la·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh way·yaḵ dā·wiḏ ba·’ă·rām ‘eś·rîm- ū·šə·na·yim ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah David struck down twenty-two . . . thousand of their men
verses.literalPt: Quando os siros de Damasco vieram socorrer a Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, Davi matou dos siros vinte e dois mil homens.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם דָּוִ֤ד נְצִבִים֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַתְּהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔ד לַעֲבָדִ֖ים נוֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤שַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem dā·wiḏ nə·ṣi·ḇîm ba·’ă·ram dam·me·śeq wat·tə·hî ’ă·rām lə·ḏā·wiḏ la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm nō·wś·’ê min·ḥāh way·yō·ša‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went
verses.literalPt: Davi pôs guarnições em Síria de Damasco; os siros tornaram-se servos de Davi e pagavam-lhe tributos. Jeová guardava a Davi por onde quer que ele ia.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗ד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ אֶ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ dā·wiḏ ’êṯ šil·ṭê haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer hā·yū ’el ‘aḇ·ḏê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer way·ḇî·’êm yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Tomou Davi os escudos de ouro, de que usavam os servos de Hadadezer, e levou-os para Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּמִבֶּ֥טַח וּמִבֵּֽרֹתַ֖י עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר לָקַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·be·ṭaḥ ū·mib·bê·rō·ṯay ‘ā·rê hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer lā·qaḥ ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ nə·ḥō·šeṯ har·bêh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: And from Betah and Berothai cities of Hadadezer King David took a large amount of bronze
verses.literalPt: De Betá e de Berotai, cidades de Hadadezer, tomou o rei Davi bronze em grande quantidade.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עִי מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ חֵ֥יל הֲדַדְעָֽזֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ tō·‘î me·leḵ ḥă·māṯ kî hik·kāh ḏā·wiḏ ’êṯ kāl- ḥêl hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer
verses.literal: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer
verses.literalPt: Quando Toí, rei de Hamate, ouviu que Davi ferira toda a hoste de Hadadezer,

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח תֹּ֣עִי אֶת־ יֽוֹרָם־ בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִד לִשְׁאָל־ ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עִי הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וּבְיָד֗וֹ הָי֛וּ כְּלֵֽי־ כֶ֥סֶף וּכְלֵֽי־ זָהָ֖ב וּכְלֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ tō·‘î ’eṯ- yō·w·rām- bə·nōw ’el- ham·me·leḵ- dā·wiḏ liš·’āl- lōw lə·šā·lō·wm ū·lə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ‘al ’ă·šer nil·ḥam ba·hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer way·yak·kê·hū kî- ’îš mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ tō·‘î hā·yāh hă·ḏaḏ·‘ā·zer ū·ḇə·yā·ḏōw hā·yū kə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḵə·lê- zā·hāḇ ū·ḵə·lê nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer who . . . had been at war with Toi Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze
verses.literalPt: enviou-lhe seu filho Jorão para o saudar e para o abençoar, porque tinha pelejado contra Hadadezer e porque o tinha batido. Pois Hadadezer, de contínuo, fazia guerra a Toí. Jorão trouxe na sua mão vasos de prata, vasos de ouro e vasos de bronze,

verses.original: גַּם־ אֹתָ֕ם הִקְדִּ֛ישׁ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לַֽיהוָ֑ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֔ישׁ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כִּבֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ō·ṯām hiq·dîš ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ Yah·weh ‘im- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ ’ă·šer hiq·dîš mik·kāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer kib·bêš
verses.literal: and King David dedicated these to the LORD along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued
verses.literalPt: que o rei Davi consagrou a Jeová, juntamente com a prata e ouro que tinha consagrado de todas as nações que subjugara:

verses.original: מֵאֲרָ֤ם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵ֑ק וּמִשְּׁלַ֛ל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ צוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ă·rām ū·mim·mō·w·’āḇ ū·mib·bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn ū·mip·pə·liš·tîm ū·mê·‘ă·mā·lêq ū·miš·šə·lal hă·ḏaḏ·‘e·zer ben- rə·ḥōḇ me·leḵ ṣō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: from Edom and Moab from the Ammonites . . . and Philistines and Amalekites and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob king of Zobah
verses.literalPt: da Síria, e de Moabe, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus, e de Amaleque, e dos despojos de Hadadezer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ שֵׁ֔ם בְּשֻׁב֕וֹ מֵהַכּוֹת֥וֹ אֶת־ אֲרָ֖ם בְּגֵיא־ מֶ֑לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś dā·wiḏ šêm bə·šu·ḇōw mê·hak·kō·w·ṯōw ’eṯ- ’ă·rām bə·ḡê- me·laḥ šə·mō·w·nāh ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄
verses.literal: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen . . . thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt . . .
verses.literalPt: Davi adquiriu para si grande nome, quando voltou de ferir os siros, no vale do Sal, uns dezoito mil homens.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם בֶּאֱד֜וֹם נְצִבִ֗ים בְּכָל־ אֱדוֹם֙ שָׂ֣ם נְצִבִ֔ים וַיְהִ֥י כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑ד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem be·’ĕ·ḏō·wm nə·ṣi·ḇîm bə·ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm śām nə·ṣi·ḇîm way·hî ḵāl ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer hā·lāḵ
verses.literal: He placed garrisons throughout Edom and all the Edomites . . . . . . were subject to David So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went
verses.literalPt: Pôs guarnições em Edom; em todo o Edom pôs guarnições, e todos os edomitas tornaram-se servos de Davi. Jeová guardava a Davi por onde quer que ele ia.

verses.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lōḵ dā·wiḏ ‘al- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ḏā·wiḏ ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people
verses.literalPt: Reinou Davi sobre todo o Israel e administrava o juízo e a justiça a todo o seu povo.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh ‘al- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- ’ă·ḥî·lūḏ maz·kîr
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder
verses.literalPt: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era sobre o exército; Josafá, filho de Ailude, era cronista;

verses.original: וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲחִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה סוֹפֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ wa·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ ben- ’eḇ·yā·ṯār kō·hă·nîm ū·śə·rā·yāh sō·w·p̄êr
verses.literal: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests Seraiah was the scribe
verses.literalPt: Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; Seraías era secretário;

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד כֹּהֲנִ֥ים הָיֽוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî ū·ḇə·nê ḏā·wiḏ kō·hă·nîm hā·yū
verses.literal: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites and David’s sons were priestly leaders
verses.literalPt: Benaia, filho de Joiada, era sobre os quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram ministros de Estado.
